maya: Quick async standup — model onboarding + evals update (what I did / blockers / today)

maya: What I did: ingested spanish-llama3-tinyq into staging, kicked a 50k-prompt eval, smoke runs looked fine initially but full reranker precision dipped.

liam: can you drop the eval link and the exact metric numbers?

maya: eval-bot: run complete -> https://redwood.internal/evals/1723, rerank.precision@50 = 0.842 (baseline 0.878)

maya: Blocker: one shard in the spanish promptset (shard_003.jsonl) has mixed encoding; KV cache warmup fails intermittently with UnicodeDecodeError. Some eval jobs hang on warmup.

oliver: ugh. can you paste the shard filename and a quick repro command?

maya: repro: docker exec -it eval-runner -- bash -lc 'python3 ingest.py --shard shards/shard_003.jsonl --validate' -> fails with: "UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x9f in position 243"

maya: Plan: strip non-UTF8 lines, run a 2k-smoke, then full eval. I opened PR #789 to add tokenizer normalization (small change) — would appreciate a reviewer.

liam: I can review #789 this afternoon. also try rerunning with PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 to see if pipeline env fixes it temporarily.

maya: good call, i'll try that now. scheduling pairing with @oliver at 4:00pm PT to triage rerank gap if review doesn't surface a tokenization bug.

eval-bot: Notice: deployed quant profile tinyq-v2 to staging for latency/throughput smoke; profile expires in 6h.

zuri: Heads up — if rerank gap stays >3% after fixes, we should rollback canary to llama3-rerank-v1 and open a short postmortem. pinging @eng-ml-oncall for visibility.

maya: Today (action items): 1) attempt PYTHONIOENCODING fix, 2) clean shard_003 and run 2k smoke, 3) request PR review and iterate on tokenizer normalizer, 4) run full eval and compare rerank metrics vs baseline, 5) flag for rollback if gap persists.

oliver: ack. i'll join 4pm PT and help parse logs. liam — leave a review comment when you have a minute, pls.

maya: thanks all — will post short update in this thread after the 2k smoke. :pray:
